activities.description: A test tube filled with clear liquid (HCl) is shown.
Magnesium metal (Mg) is added to the test tube, causing a vigorous bubbling reaction. The reaction continues until the magnesium metal disappears.
The test tube is secured with a clamp.
A burning splint is brought near the opening of the test tube. The gas inside ignites with a pop sound and a brief flame.
